entries.22846183d3d93e08: A company that manufactures and sells secondary concrete products, supplying civil engineering materials, landscape materials and exterior products for housing to public works projects and private housing.
entries.b2e8c7e67a64554d: Owners of private housing and housing-related businesses
entries.b316437a52f8c63c: For public spaces such as sidewalks and parks, the company manufactures and sells concrete paving materials, curbstones, stair blocks, imitation wood and imitation stone. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,538 million.
entries.b9ed7542b1d572d1: Public works clients such as national and local governments
entries.dda2178300085345: For private housing, the company manufactures and sells residential exterior products, mainly standing water taps, along with garden products, decorative blocks and gate posts. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,004 million. The consolidated subsidiary Nikko Exterior Co., Ltd. sells some of the company's products nationwide, and the company purchases some of the products handled by that subsidiary.
entries.fe2458be61a844f2: Clients for public facilities such as national and local governments
